      const u = i / (BN3 - 1);
      P.r[k] = lerp(Rm, rj, u); P.d[k] = hr + (hj - hr) * u * u; P.sph[k] = 1; P.mat[k] = -1; P.pet[k] = 1 - u;
    }
    const xj = sphereDip(rj) + hj;
    for (let i = 0; i < BODY_A.length; i++, k++) {
      const a = Math.max(BODY_A[i], c);
      P.r[k] = bulletR0(a) * (1 + beta * Math.exp(-(a - c) / 0.16)); P.d[k] = xj + (a - c); P.sph[k] = 0; P.mat[k] = a; P.pet[k] = 0;
    }
    const xe = xj + (BUL.L - c), re = P.r[k - 1];
    for (let i = 0; i < BN5; i++, k++) {
      const u = i / (BN5 - 1);
      P.r[k] = re * (1 - u); P.d[k] = xe; P.sph[k] = 0; P.mat[k] = BUL.L + 1; P.pet[k] = 0;
    }
    for (k = 0; k < BNP; k++) P.x[k] = (P.sph[k] ? sphereDip(P.r[k]) : 0) + P.d[k];
    const kBase = BNP - BN5;
    for (k = 0; k < BNP; k++) {
      if (k >= kBase) { P.nx[k] = 1; P.nr[k] = 0; continue; }
      let a = Math.max(0, k - 1), b = Math.min(kBase - 1, k + 1);
      let tx = P.x[b] - P.x[a], tr = P.r[b] - P.r[a];
      while (tx * tx + tr * tr < 1e-12 && (a > 0 || b < kBase - 1)) {
        if (a > 0) a--;
        if (b < kBase - 1) b++;
        tx = P.x[b] - P.x[a]; tr = P.r[b] - P.r[a];
      }
      const l = Math.hypot(tx, tr) || 1;
      P.nx[k] = -tr / l; P.nr[k] = tx / l;
    }
    P.nx[0] = -1; P.nr[0] = 0;
    const petAmp = smoothstep(0.03, 0.35, c);
    const pos = B.pos, nor = B.nor, col = B.col;
    let v = 0;
    for (k = 0; k < BNP; k++) {
      const m = P.mat[k];
      for (let j = 0; j <= BNR; j++, v++) {
        const phi = (j / BNR) * Math.PI * 2, cs = Math.cos(phi), sn = Math.sin(phi);
        let r = P.r[k], x = P.x[k];
        if (P.sph[k]) {                         // ragged petals on the mushroom cap
          r *= 1 + petAmp * P.pet[k] * (0.10 * Math.sin(5 * phi + 0.7) + 0.06 * Math.sin(11 * phi + 2.1));
          x = sphereDip(r) + P.d[k];
        }
        pos[v * 3] = x; pos[v * 3 + 1] = r * cs; pos[v * 3 + 2] = r * sn;
        nor[v * 3] = P.nx[k]; nor[v * 3 + 1] = P.nr[k] * cs; nor[v * 3 + 2] = P.nr[k] * sn;
        let cr, cg, cb;
        if (m < 0) { cr = 0.66; cg = 0.67; cb = 0.71; }                  // freshly smeared lead
        else if (m <= BUL.LEAD) { cr = 0.47; cg = 0.48; cb = 0.52; }     // lead nose
        else {                                                           // copper jacket with rifling marks
          const land = (1 - 0.30 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.95, Math.cos(6 * phi + 2.4 * m))) * (m > BUL.L ? 0.7 : 1);
          cr = 0.93 * land; cg = 0.56 * land; cb = 0.36 * land;
        }
        col[v * 3] = cr; col[v * 3 + 1] = cg; col[v * 3 + 2] = cb;
      }
    }
    const at = B.mesh ? B.mesh.geometry.attributes : null;
    if (at) { at.position.needsUpdate = true; at.normal.needsUpdate = true; at.color.needsUpdate = true; }
  }

  /* radial spall droplets thrown off the mushroom rim (instanced, analytic trajectories) */
  const G_SPALL = 2.4;
  function buildSpall(material) {
    const n = N_SPALL;
    const D = { n: n };
    const keys = ['tau', 'x0', 'y0', 'z0', 'vx', 'vy', 'vz', 'size', 'k', 'f0'];
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) D[keys[i]] = new Float32Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const tau = 0.015 + 0.56 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.7);
      const phi = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, cy = Math.cos(phi), cz = Math.sin(phi);
      const kap = -0.18 + 0.95 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.5);                   // cone angle: mostly radial, some thrown back
      const v = (2.0 + 5.0 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.4)) * (1.25 - 0.6 * tau / 0.575);
      const rm = mushroomRadius(consumed(tau));
      D.tau[i] = tau;
      D.x0[i] = CONTACT.x + sphereDip(rm) + 0.03; D.y0[i] = CONTACT.y + cy * rm; D.z0[i] = cz * rm;
      D.vx[i] = v * Math.sin(kap); D.vy[i] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cy; D.vz[i] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cz * 0.55;
      D.size[i] = 0.008 + 0.034 * Math.pow(rnd(), 2.4);
      D.k[i] = 0.25 + 0.3 * rnd();
      D.f0[i] = 2.45 + 0.55 * rnd();
    }
    const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1), material, n);
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
    return { mesh: mesh, data: D };
  }

  /* fine lead spray: same cone, far more drag */
  function buildLeadSpray(material) {
    const n = N_LEAD;
    const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), velBirth = new Float32Array(n * 4), misc = new Float32Array(n * 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const tau = 0.01 + 0.6 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.5);
      const phi = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, cy = Math.cos(phi), cz = Math.sin(phi);
      const kap = -0.25 + 1.1 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.3);
      const v = 1.2 + 6.5 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.6);
      const rm = mushroomRadius(consumed(tau));
      pos[i * 3] = CONTACT.x + sphereDip(rm) + 0.03; pos[i * 3 + 1] = CONTACT.y + cy * rm; pos[i * 3 + 2] = cz * rm;
      velBirth[i * 4] = v * Math.sin(kap); velBirth[i * 4 + 1] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cy; velBirth[i * 4 + 2] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cz * 0.55;
      velBirth[i * 4 + 3] = T_IMPACT + tau;
      misc[i * 4] = rnd(); misc[i * 4 + 1] = 1.0 + 2.4 * rnd(); misc[i * 4 + 2] = 0.6 + 1.0 * rnd();
      misc[i * 4 + 3] = 0.012 + 0.03 * Math.pow(rnd(), 2);
    }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    g.setAttribute('aVelBirth', new THREE.BufferAttribute(velBirth, 4));
    g.setAttribute('aMisc', new THREE.BufferAttribute(misc, 4));
    const pts = new THREE.Points(g, material);
    pts.frustumCulled = false;
    return pts;
  }

  /* =====================================================================
   *  Steel end-nippers, clamp, glows
   * ===================================================================== */
  const NIP = { LJ: 0.78, HANDLE: 16, OPEN: 26 * Math.PI / 180, TOUCH: 3.9 * Math.PI / 180, HOVER: 0.46 };

  function nipperShape(sg) {                    // one lever: curved jaw on one side of the pivot, handle on the other
    const sh = new THREE.Shape();
    sh.moveTo(0.78, 0);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.812, 0.04 * sg, 0.824, 0.10 * sg, 0.80, 0.16 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.76, 0.28 * sg, 0.66, 0.38 * sg, 0.52, 0.41 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.38, 0.44 * sg, 0.24, 0.43 * sg, 0.10, 0.40 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-0.06, 0.37 * sg, -0.22, 0.32 * sg, -0.30, 0.20 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-0.40, 0.06 * sg, -0.55, -0.10 * sg, -0.75, -0.16 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-1.10, -0.25 * sg, -1.50, -0.21 * sg, -1.90, -0.20 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(-NIP.HANDLE, -0.22 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(-NIP.HANDLE, -0.44 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(-1.90, -0.42 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-1.30, -0.43 * sg, -0.75, -0.45 * sg, -0.35, -0.33 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-0.12, -0.37 * sg, 0.12, -0.32 * sg, 0.22, -0.20 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.29, -0.12 * sg, 0.30, -0.04 * sg, 0.28, 0.02 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.27, 0.10 * sg, 0.38, 0.18 * sg, 0.50, 0.185 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.62, 0.19 * sg, 0.70, 0.12 * sg, 0.72, 0.045 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(0.78, 0);
    return sh;
  }
  function buildNippers(steel, dark) {
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const ext = { depth: 0.05, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.012, bevelSize: 0.012, bevelSegments: 2, curveSegments: 12, steps: 1 };
    const ga = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(nipperShape(1), ext);
    ga.translate(0, 0, 0.012);
    const gb = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(nipperShape(-1), ext);
    gb.translate(0, 0, -0.062);
    const a = new THREE.Mesh(ga, steel), b = new THREE.Mesh(gb, steel);
    const bolt = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.095, 0.095, 0.19, 28), dark);
    bolt.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.215, 6), steel);
    cap.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    group.add(a, b, bolt, cap);
    a.frustumCulled = b.frustumCulled = false;
    return { group: group, a: a, b: b };
  }

  function buildClamp(metal, rubber) {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    const rN = CLAMP.r;
    const rod = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.055, 0.055, 22, 20), metal);
    rod.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
    rod.position.set(-11.66, 0, 0);
    const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.30, 0.22, 0.30), metal);
    head.position.set(-0.56, 0, 0);
    for (let sg = -1; sg <= 1; sg += 2) {
      const prong = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.62, 0.095, 0.04), metal);
      prong.position.set(-0.13, 0, sg * (rN + 0.032));
      const pad = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.17, 0.08, 0.012), rubber);
      pad.position.set(0, 0, sg * (rN + 0.006));
      g.add(prong, pad);
    }
    const screw = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.028, 0.028, 0.2, 12), metal);
    screw.position.set(-0.56, 0.16, 0);
    const knob = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.075, 0.075, 0.045, 14), metal);
    knob.position.set(-0.56, 0.27, 0);
    g.add(rod, head, screw, knob);
    g.position.set(CLAMP.x, CLAMP.y, CLAMP.z);
    return g;
  }

  function makeGlow(r, g, b, streak) {
    const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { uColor: { value: new THREE.Vector3(r, g, b) }, uI: { value: 0 }, uStreak: { value: streak } },
      vertexShader: GLOW_VERT, fragmentShader: GLOW_FRAG,
      transparent: true, depthTest: false, depthWrite: false,
      blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendEquation: THREE.AddEquation, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneFactor
    });
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1), mat);
    m.frustumCulled = false;
    m.renderOrder = 40;
    return m;
  }

  /* =====================================================================
   *  Scene assembly
   * ===================================================================== */
  let S = null;                                 // everything renderAt() touches
  let simTime = 0;

  function initScene() {
    if (typeof THREE === 'undefined') return null;
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: document.getElementById('stage'), antialias: true, alpha: true });
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, false);
    renderer.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.0;
    renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(FOV, 1, 1, 200);
    const envTex = buildEnvironment(renderer);    // PMREM of the in-memory light-box
    scene.environment = envTex;

    // three-point studio lighting: cool key, soft fill, cyan + magenta rims
    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe4eeff, 1.5);
    key.position.set(KEY_POS[0], KEY_POS[1], KEY_POS[2]);
    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8ea6d4, 0.35);
    fill.position.set(7.6, -0.8, 6.2);
    const rimC = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x33e0ff, 1.2);
    rimC.position.set(CYAN_POS[0], CYAN_POS[1], CYAN_POS[2]);
    const rimM = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xff3dd0, 1.05);
    rimM.position.set(MAG_POS[0], MAG_POS[1], MAG_POS[2]);
    const amb = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x7486ad, 0x0a0b10, 0.22);
    const flashLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xa9d2ff, 0, 7, 2);
    flashLight.position.set(CUT.x, CUT.y, 0.5);
    scene.add(key, fill, rimC, rimM, amb, flashLight);

    const U = {
      uTime: { value: 0 },
      uPx: { value: 1 },
      uLen: { value: SP.L },
      uOrders: { value: 1.6 },
      uFringeGain: { value: 0.4 },
      uSway: { value: new THREE.Vector2() },
      uRing: { value: new THREE.Vector2() },
      uPulse: { value: new THREE.Vector3(-1, -1, 0) },
      uImpact: { value: new THREE.Vector4(CONTACT.x, CONTACT.y, 0, 0) },
      uFlash: { value: new THREE.Vector4(CUT.x, CUT.y, CUT.z, 0) },
      envMap: { value: envTex }
    };

    // ---- the drop: back faces, then front faces, both light-additive over the backdrop
    const dropGeo = buildDropGeometry();
    const glassUniforms = {
      envMap: U.envMap, uTime: U.uTime, uLen: U.uLen, uOrders: U.uOrders, uFringeGain: U.uFringeGain,
      uSway: U.uSway, uRing: U.uRing, uPulse: U.uPulse, uImpact: U.uImpact, uFlash: U.uFlash
    };
    const glassBack = new THREE.Mesh(dropGeo, new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: glassUniforms, vertexShader: GLASS_VERT, fragmentShader: GLASS_FRAG, defines: { BACK_PASS: 1 },
      transparent: true, depthWrite: false, premultipliedAlpha: true, side: THREE.BackSide
    }));
    const glassFront = new THREE.Mesh(dropGeo, new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: glassUniforms, vertexShader: GLASS_VERT, fragmentShader: GLASS_FRAG,
      transparent: true, depthWrite: false, premultipliedAlpha: true, side: THREE.FrontSide
    }));
    glassBack.renderOrder = 10;
    glassFront.renderOrder = 11;
    glassBack.frustumCulled = glassFront.frustumCulled = false;

    const frost = new THREE.Mesh(dropGeo, new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uLen: U.uLen }, vertexShader: FROST_VERT, fragmentShader: FROST_FRAG, side: THREE.DoubleSide
    }));
    frost.frustumCulled = false;

    const shards = buildShards(new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, envMap: U.envMap }, vertexShader: SHARD_VERT, fragmentShader: SHARD_FRAG, side: THREE.DoubleSide
    }));

    const additive = function (params) {
      params.transparent = true; params.depthWrite = false;
      params.blending = THREE.CustomBlending; params.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
      params.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor; params.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
      return new THREE.ShaderMaterial(params);
    };
    const dust = buildDust(additive({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uPx: U.uPx, uLife: { value: new THREE.Vector2(50, 60) }, uColor: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0.22, 0.26, 0.32) } },
      vertexShader: DUST_VERT, fragmentShader: DUST_FRAG
    }));
    const lead = buildLeadSpray(additive({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uPx: U.uPx, uLife: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5, 1.7) }, uColor: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0.20, 0.21, 0.24) } },
      vertexShader: DUST_VERT, fragmentShader: DUST_FRAG
    }));
    const glints = buildGlints(shards, additive({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uPx: U.uPx }, vertexShader: GLINT_VERT, fragmentShader: GLINT_FRAG
    }));
    dust.renderOrder = 20; lead.renderOrder = 20; glints.renderOrder = 21;

    // ---- metals
    const brushed = brushedTexture();
    const steel = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x8d939c, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.70, roughnessMap: brushed, bumpMap: brushed, bumpScale: 0.0005, envMapIntensity: 1.0
    });
    const boltMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3a3d44, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.38 });
    const anodized = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x15171d, metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.42, envMapIntensity: 0.9 });
    const rubber = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x060607, metalness: 0.0, roughness: 0.9 });
    const bulletMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.40, envMapIntensity: 1.1 });
    const spallMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x70747c, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.36, envMapIntensity: 0.85 });

    const nip = buildNippers(steel, boltMat);
    const dl = Math.hypot(CUT.tx, CUT.ty) || 1;
    nip.dx = CUT.tx / dl; nip.dy = CUT.ty / dl;           // tail direction at the cut: the tool's long axis
    nip.rot = Math.atan2(-nip.dy, -nip.dx);
    nip.px = CUT.x + nip.dx * NIP.LJ; nip.py = CUT.y + nip.dy * NIP.LJ;
    const clampRig = buildClamp(anodized, rubber);
    const bullet = buildBullet(bulletMat);
    const spall = buildSpall(spallMat);

    const flash = makeGlow(0.50, 0.72, 1.0, 1.0);
    const frontGlow = makeGlow(0.60, 0.80, 1.0, 0.0);
    const burst = makeGlow(0.65, 0.82, 1.0, 0.0);
    const spark = makeGlow(1.0, 0.82, 0.60, 0.6);

    scene.add(glassBack, glassFront, frost, shards.mesh, dust, lead, glints, nip.group, clampRig,
      bullet.mesh, spall.mesh, flash, frontGlow, burst, spark);

    S = {
      renderer: renderer, scene: scene, camera: camera, U: U,
      glassBack: glassBack, glassFront: glassFront, frost: frost, shards: shards.mesh, dust: dust, lead: lead, glints: glints,
      nip: nip, bullet: bullet, spall: spall, flash: flash, frontGlow: frontGlow, burst: burst, spark: spark, flashLight: flashLight,
      tmp: {
        o: {}, m4: new THREE.Matrix4(), q: new THREE.Quaternion(), p: new THREE.Vector3(), sc: new THREE.Vector3(),
        dir: new THREE.Vector3(), xAxis: new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), zero: new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(0, 0, 0)
      }
    };
    fitCamera();
    renderer.compile(scene, camera);
    const warm = [1.5, 3.95, 5.0, 6.6];           // touch every program / buffer once so nothing hitches mid-shot
    for (let i = 0; i < warm.length; i++) renderAt(warm[i]);
    return S;
  }

  /* fixed 35-degree camera on +Z; distance chosen so the drop sits inside the central 70 % */
  function fitCamera() {
    const w = window.innerWidth, h = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
    const aspect = w / h, tanH = Math.tan(FOV * Math.PI / 360), FILL = 0.66;
    const dist = Math.max(SP.halfH / (FILL * tanH), SP.halfW / (FILL * tanH * aspect));
    S.camera.aspect = aspect;
    S.camera.position.set(0, 0, dist);
    S.camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    S.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    const buf = S.renderer.getDrawingBufferSize(new THREE.Vector2());
    S.U.uPx.value = buf.y / (2 * tanH);
  }

  /* =====================================================================
   *  Analytic state: every quantity below is a closed-form function of t
   * ===================================================================== */
  function swayLower(t) {                       // head ringing after the hit (cantilevered from the clamp)
    if (t <= T_IMPACT) return 0;
    const tau = t - T_IMPACT, win = 1 - smoothstep(2.9, 3.6, t);
    return -win * (0.060 * Math.exp(-2.4 * tau) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5.2 * tau) +
                   0.036 * Math.exp(-1.5 * tau) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1.45 * tau));
  }
  function swayUpper(t) {
    if (t <= T_IMPACT) return 0;
    const tau = t - T_IMPACT, win = 1 - smoothstep(2.9, 3.6, t);
    return win * 0.016 * Math.exp(-2.0 * tau) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 7.5 * tau);
  }
  const BULB_SWAY_W = Math.pow((S_CLAMP - S_BULB) / S_CLAMP, 2);
  const SHIFT_DET = swayLower(T_IMPACT + BUL.TDET) * BULB_SWAY_W;

  function updateBullet(t, shift) {
    const B = S.bullet, m = B.mesh, tau = t - T_IMPACT;
    if (tau <= 0) {                             // free flight, +X -> -X
      setBulletShape(B, 0);
      m.position.set(CONTACT.x - BUL.V * tau, CONTACT.y, 0);
      m.rotation.set(BUL.SPIN * t, 0, 0);
      m.visible = true;
      return;
    }
    setBulletShape(B, consumed(tau));
    const spin = BUL.SPIN * T_IMPACT + BUL.SPIN * (1 - Math.exp(-8 * tau)) / 8;
    if (tau <= BUL.TDET) {                      // pinned against the ringing bulb while it mushrooms
      m.position.set(CONTACT.x + shift, CONTACT.y, 0);
      m.rotation.set(spin, 0, 0);
      m.visible = true;
    } else {                                    // spent slug rebounds, tumbles and drops away
      const td = tau - BUL.TDET;
      m.position.set(CONTACT.x + SHIFT_DET + 0.55 * td, CONTACT.y + 0.18 * td - 1.25 * td * td, 0.25 * td);
      m.rotation.set(spin, 0, -0.95 * td);
      m.visible = m.position.y > -14;
    }
  }

  function updateSpall(t) {
    const mesh = S.spall.mesh, D = S.spall.data, T = S.tmp;
    if (t <= T_IMPACT || t >= 3.9) { mesh.visible = false; return; }
    mesh.visible = true;
    const tau0 = t - T_IMPACT;
    for (let i = 0; i < D.n; i++) {
      const age = tau0 - D.tau[i];
      const life = 1 - smoothstep(D.f0[i], D.f0[i] + 0.7, t);
      if (age <= 0 || life <= 0) { mesh.setMatrixAt(i, T.zero); continue; }
      const k = D.k[i], e = 1 - Math.exp(-k * age), f = e / k, ek = 1 - e;
      T.p.set(D.x0[i] + D.vx[i] * f, D.y0[i] + D.vy[i] * f - G_SPALL * (age - f) / k, D.z0[i] + D.vz[i] * f);
      T.dir.set(D.vx[i] * ek, D.vy[i] * ek - G_SPALL * e / k, D.vz[i] * ek);
      const speed = T.dir.length() || 1;
      T.dir.multiplyScalar(1 / speed);
      T.q.setFromUnitVectors(T.xAxis, T.dir);
      const sz = D.size[i] * life * smoothstep(0, 0.05, age);
      T.sc.set(sz * (1 + Math.min(2.6, speed * 0.33)), sz, sz);   // molten streaks stretch along their flight
      T.m4.compose(T.p, T.q, T.sc);
      mesh.setMatrixAt(i, T.m4);
    }
    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  function updateNippers(t) {
    const N = S.nip;
    const adv = easeInOut((t - 2.6) / 0.75);
    let back = NIP.HOVER * (1 - adv) + 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 2.3) * (1 - adv);
    let ang;
    if (t <= 2.75) ang = NIP.OPEN;
    else if (t <= T_TOUCH) ang = lerp(NIP.OPEN, NIP.TOUCH, easeInOut((t - 2.75) / (T_TOUCH - 2.75)));
    else if (t <= T_SNIP) { const u = (t - T_TOUCH) / (T_SNIP - T_TOUCH); ang = NIP.TOUCH * (1 - u * u); }
    else ang = 0;
    let kick = 0;
    if (t > T_SNIP) {                           // snap recoil, then the tool backs away
      const ts = t - T_SNIP;
      kick = 0.022 * Math.exp(-9 * ts) * Math.sin(46 * ts);
      back += 0.02 * Math.exp(-7 * ts) * Math.sin(40 * ts) + 0.8 * smoothstep(4.6, 6.4, t);
      ang = 0.16 * smoothstep(4.9, 6.3, t);
    }
    N.group.position.set(N.px + N.dx * back, N.py + N.dy * back, 0);
    N.group.rotation.z = N.rot + kick;
    N.a.rotation.z = ang / 2;
    N.b.rotation.z = -ang / 2;
  }

  function setGlow(m, x, y, z, scale, intensity) {
    m.visible = intensity > 0.003;
    m.position.set(x, y, z);
    m.scale.set(scale, scale, 1);
    m.material.uniforms.uI.value = intensity;
  }
  function updateGlows(t) {
    // triboluminescent flash at the cut
    let fI = 0;
    const ts = t - (T_SNIP - 0.03);
    if (ts > 0) fI = smoothstep(0, 0.07, ts) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0, ts - 0.07) / 0.16) * (0.86 + 0.14 * Math.sin(ts * 90));
    S.U.uFlash.value.w = fI;
    S.flashLight.intensity = 2.2 * fI;
    setGlow(S.flash, CUT.x, CUT.y, 0.2, 1.3 + 2.0 * fI, 2.0 * fI);
    // glow riding on the crack front
    let gI = 0, gs = 1, gx = CUT.x, gy = CUT.y, gz = 0;
    if (t > T_SNIP && t < T_WAVE1 + 0.5) {
      const o = spineAt(frontS(t), S.tmp.o);
      gx = o.x; gy = o.y; gz = o.z;
      gI = (t < T_WAVE0 ? 0.45 * smoothstep(T_SNIP, T_SNIP + 0.15, t) : 0.85) * (t > T_WAVE1 ? Math.exp(-(t - T_WAVE1) / 0.1) : 1);
      gs = 0.55 + 4.2 * o.r;
    }
    setGlow(S.frontGlow, gx, gy, gz + 0.1, gs, gI);
    // the head letting go
    const bI = smoothstep(T_WAVE1 - 0.22, T_WAVE1, t) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0, t - T_WAVE1) / 0.2);
    setGlow(S.burst, BULB.x, BULB.y, 0.3, 3.0 + 2.2 * smoothstep(T_WAVE1 - 0.2, T_WAVE1 + 0.5, t), 0.8 * bI);
    // spark where lead meets glass

   *  Prince Rupert's Drop — bullet impact vs. tail snip
   *  Every visual is a pure function of simTime in [0, DURATION]:
   *  renderAt(simTime) evaluates the whole scene analytically, so forward

    for (let i = 0; i < BN1; i++, k++) {
      const u = i / (BN1 - 1);
      P.r[k] = Rm * u; P.d[k] = 0; P.sph[k] = 1; P.mat[k] = -1; P.pet[k] = u;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < BN2; i++, k++) {
      const a = Math.PI * (i + 1) / (BN2 + 1);
      P.r[k] = Rm + 0.45 * hr * Math.sin(a); P.d[k] = 0.5 * hr * (1 - Math.cos(a)); P.sph[k] = 1; P.mat[k] = -1; P.pet[k] = 1;
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < BN3; i++, k++) {
      const u = i / (BN3 - 1);
      P.r[k] = lerp(Rm, rj, u); P.d[k] = hr + (hj - hr) * u * u; P.sph[k] = 1; P.mat[k] = -1; P.pet[k] = 1 - u;
    }
    const xj = sphereDip(rj) + hj;
    for (let i = 0; i < BODY_A.length; i++, k++) {
      const a = Math.max(BODY_A[i], c);
      P.r[k] = bulletR0(a) * (1 + beta * Math.exp(-(a - c) / 0.16)); P.d[k] = xj + (a - c); P.sph[k] = 0; P.mat[k] = a; P.pet[k] = 0;
    }
    const xe = xj + (BUL.L - c), re = P.r[k - 1];
    for (let i = 0; i < BN5; i++, k++) {
      const u = i / (BN5 - 1);
      P.r[k] = re * (1 - u); P.d[k] = xe; P.sph[k] = 0; P.mat[k] = BUL.L + 1; P.pet[k] = 0;
    }
    for (k = 0; k < BNP; k++) P.x[k] = (P.sph[k] ? sphereDip(P.r[k]) : 0) + P.d[k];
    const kBase = BNP - BN5;
    for (k = 0; k < BNP; k++) {
      if (k >= kBase) { P.nx[k] = 1; P.nr[k] = 0; continue; }
      let a = Math.max(0, k - 1), b = Math.min(kBase - 1, k + 1);
      let tx = P.x[b] - P.x[a], tr = P.r[b] - P.r[a];
      while (tx * tx + tr * tr < 1e-12 && (a > 0 || b < kBase - 1)) {
        if (a > 0) a--;
        if (b < kBase - 1) b++;
        tx = P.x[b] - P.x[a]; tr = P.r[b] - P.r[a];
      }
      const l = Math.hypot(tx, tr) || 1;
      P.nx[k] = -tr / l; P.nr[k] = tx / l;
    }
    P.nx[0] = -1; P.nr[0] = 0;
    const petAmp = smoothstep(0.03, 0.35, c);
    const pos = B.pos, nor = B.nor, col = B.col;
    let v = 0;
    for (k = 0; k < BNP; k++) {
      const m = P.mat[k];
      for (let j = 0; j <= BNR; j++, v++) {
        const phi = (j / BNR) * Math.PI * 2, cs = Math.cos(phi), sn = Math.sin(phi);
        let r = P.r[k], x = P.x[k];
        if (P.sph[k]) {                         // ragged petals on the mushroom cap
          r *= 1 + petAmp * P.pet[k] * (0.10 * Math.sin(5 * phi + 0.7) + 0.06 * Math.sin(11 * phi + 2.1));
          x = sphereDip(r) + P.d[k];
        }
        pos[v * 3] = x; pos[v * 3 + 1] = r * cs; pos[v * 3 + 2] = r * sn;
        nor[v * 3] = P.nx[k]; nor[v * 3 + 1] = P.nr[k] * cs; nor[v * 3 + 2] = P.nr[k] * sn;
        let cr, cg, cb;
        if (m < 0) { cr = 0.66; cg = 0.67; cb = 0.71; }                  // freshly smeared lead
        else if (m <= BUL.LEAD) { cr = 0.47; cg = 0.48; cb = 0.52; }     // lead nose
        else {                                                           // copper jacket with rifling marks
          const land = (1 - 0.30 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.95, Math.cos(6 * phi + 2.4 * m))) * (m > BUL.L ? 0.7 : 1);
          cr = 0.93 * land; cg = 0.56 * land; cb = 0.36 * land;
        }
        col[v * 3] = cr; col[v * 3 + 1] = cg; col[v * 3 + 2] = cb;
      }
    }
    const at = B.mesh ? B.mesh.geometry.attributes : null;
    if (at) { at.position.needsUpdate = true; at.normal.needsUpdate = true; at.color.needsUpdate = true; }
  }

  /* radial spall droplets thrown off the mushroom rim (instanced, analytic trajectories) */
  const G_SPALL = 2.4;
  function buildSpall(material) {
    const n = N_SPALL;
    const D = { n: n };
    const keys = ['tau', 'x0', 'y0', 'z0', 'vx', 'vy', 'vz', 'size', 'k', 'f0'];
    for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) D[keys[i]] = new Float32Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const tau = 0.015 + 0.56 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.7);
      const phi = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, cy = Math.cos(phi), cz = Math.sin(phi);
      const kap = -0.18 + 0.95 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.5);                   // cone angle: mostly radial, some thrown back
      const v = (2.0 + 5.0 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.4)) * (1.25 - 0.6 * tau / 0.575);
      const rm = mushroomRadius(consumed(tau));
      D.tau[i] = tau;
      D.x0[i] = CONTACT.x + sphereDip(rm) + 0.03; D.y0[i] = CONTACT.y + cy * rm; D.z0[i] = cz * rm;
      D.vx[i] = v * Math.sin(kap); D.vy[i] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cy; D.vz[i] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cz * 0.55;
      D.size[i] = 0.008 + 0.034 * Math.pow(rnd(), 2.4);
      D.k[i] = 0.25 + 0.3 * rnd();
      D.f0[i] = 2.45 + 0.55 * rnd();
    }
    const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1), material, n);
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
    return { mesh: mesh, data: D };
  }

  /* fine lead spray: same cone, far more drag */
  function buildLeadSpray(material) {
    const n = N_LEAD;
    const pos = new Float32Array(n * 3), velBirth = new Float32Array(n * 4), misc = new Float32Array(n * 4);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const tau = 0.01 + 0.6 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.5);
      const phi = rnd() * Math.PI * 2, cy = Math.cos(phi), cz = Math.sin(phi);
      const kap = -0.25 + 1.1 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.3);
      const v = 1.2 + 6.5 * Math.pow(rnd(), 1.6);
      const rm = mushroomRadius(consumed(tau));
      pos[i * 3] = CONTACT.x + sphereDip(rm) + 0.03; pos[i * 3 + 1] = CONTACT.y + cy * rm; pos[i * 3 + 2] = cz * rm;
      velBirth[i * 4] = v * Math.sin(kap); velBirth[i * 4 + 1] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cy; velBirth[i * 4 + 2] = v * Math.cos(kap) * cz * 0.55;
      velBirth[i * 4 + 3] = T_IMPACT + tau;
      misc[i * 4] = rnd(); misc[i * 4 + 1] = 1.0 + 2.4 * rnd(); misc[i * 4 + 2] = 0.6 + 1.0 * rnd();
      misc[i * 4 + 3] = 0.012 + 0.03 * Math.pow(rnd(), 2);
    }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    g.setAttribute('aVelBirth', new THREE.BufferAttribute(velBirth, 4));
    g.setAttribute('aMisc', new THREE.BufferAttribute(misc, 4));
    const pts = new THREE.Points(g, material);
    pts.frustumCulled = false;
    return pts;
  }

  /* =====================================================================
   *  Steel end-nippers, clamp, glows
   * ===================================================================== */
  const NIP = { LJ: 0.78, HANDLE: 16, OPEN: 26 * Math.PI / 180, TOUCH: 3.9 * Math.PI / 180, HOVER: 0.46 };

  function nipperShape(sg) {                    // one lever: curved jaw on one side of the pivot, handle on the other
    const sh = new THREE.Shape();
    sh.moveTo(0.78, 0);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.812, 0.04 * sg, 0.824, 0.10 * sg, 0.80, 0.16 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.76, 0.28 * sg, 0.66, 0.38 * sg, 0.52, 0.41 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.38, 0.44 * sg, 0.24, 0.43 * sg, 0.10, 0.40 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-0.06, 0.37 * sg, -0.22, 0.32 * sg, -0.30, 0.20 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-0.40, 0.06 * sg, -0.55, -0.10 * sg, -0.75, -0.16 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-1.10, -0.25 * sg, -1.50, -0.21 * sg, -1.90, -0.20 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(-NIP.HANDLE, -0.22 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(-NIP.HANDLE, -0.44 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(-1.90, -0.42 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-1.30, -0.43 * sg, -0.75, -0.45 * sg, -0.35, -0.33 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(-0.12, -0.37 * sg, 0.12, -0.32 * sg, 0.22, -0.20 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.29, -0.12 * sg, 0.30, -0.04 * sg, 0.28, 0.02 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.27, 0.10 * sg, 0.38, 0.18 * sg, 0.50, 0.185 * sg);
    sh.bezierCurveTo(0.62, 0.19 * sg, 0.70, 0.12 * sg, 0.72, 0.045 * sg);
    sh.lineTo(0.78, 0);
    return sh;
  }
  function buildNippers(steel, dark) {
    const group = new THREE.Group();
    const ext = { depth: 0.05, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.012, bevelSize: 0.012, bevelSegments: 2, curveSegments: 12, steps: 1 };
    const ga = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(nipperShape(1), ext);
    ga.translate(0, 0, 0.012);
    const gb = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(nipperShape(-1), ext);
    gb.translate(0, 0, -0.062);
    const a = new THREE.Mesh(ga, steel), b = new THREE.Mesh(gb, steel);
    const bolt = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.095, 0.095, 0.19, 28), dark);
    bolt.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    const cap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.215, 6), steel);
    cap.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    group.add(a, b, bolt, cap);
    a.frustumCulled = b.frustumCulled = false;
    return { group: group, a: a, b: b };
  }

  function buildClamp(metal, rubber) {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    const rN = CLAMP.r;
    const rod = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.055, 0.055, 22, 20), metal);
    rod.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
    rod.position.set(-11.66, 0, 0);
    const head = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.30, 0.22, 0.30), metal);
    head.position.set(-0.56, 0, 0);
    for (let sg = -1; sg <= 1; sg += 2) {
      const prong = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.62, 0.095, 0.04), metal);
      prong.position.set(-0.13, 0, sg * (rN + 0.032));
      const pad = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.17, 0.08, 0.012), rubber);
      pad.position.set(0, 0, sg * (rN + 0.006));
      g.add(prong, pad);
    }
    const screw = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.028, 0.028, 0.2, 12), metal);
    screw.position.set(-0.56, 0.16, 0);
    const knob = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.075, 0.075, 0.045, 14), metal);
    knob.position.set(-0.56, 0.27, 0);
    g.add(rod, head, screw, knob);
    g.position.set(CLAMP.x, CLAMP.y, CLAMP.z);
    return g;
  }

  function makeGlow(r, g, b, streak) {
    const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { uColor: { value: new THREE.Vector3(r, g, b) }, uI: { value: 0 }, uStreak: { value: streak } },
      vertexShader: GLOW_VERT, fragmentShader: GLOW_FRAG,
      transparent: true, depthTest: false, depthWrite: false,
      blending: THREE.CustomBlending, blendEquation: THREE.AddEquation, blendSrc: THREE.OneFactor, blendDst: THREE.OneFactor
    });
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1), mat);
    m.frustumCulled = false;
    m.renderOrder = 40;
    return m;
  }

  /* =====================================================================
   *  Scene assembly
   * ===================================================================== */
  let S = null;                                 // everything renderAt() touches
  let simTime = 0;

  function initScene() {
    if (typeof THREE === 'undefined') return null;
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: document.getElementById('stage'), antialias: true, alpha: true });
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, false);
    renderer.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.0;
    renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(FOV, 1, 1, 200);
    const envTex = buildEnvironment(renderer);    // PMREM of the in-memory light-box
    scene.environment = envTex;

    // three-point studio lighting: cool key, soft fill, cyan + magenta rims
    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe4eeff, 1.5);
    key.position.set(KEY_POS[0], KEY_POS[1], KEY_POS[2]);
    const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x8ea6d4, 0.35);
    fill.position.set(7.6, -0.8, 6.2);
    const rimC = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x33e0ff, 1.2);
    rimC.position.set(CYAN_POS[0], CYAN_POS[1], CYAN_POS[2]);
    const rimM = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xff3dd0, 1.05);
    rimM.position.set(MAG_POS[0], MAG_POS[1], MAG_POS[2]);
    const amb = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x7486ad, 0x0a0b10, 0.22);
    const flashLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xa9d2ff, 0, 7, 2);
    flashLight.position.set(CUT.x, CUT.y, 0.5);
    scene.add(key, fill, rimC, rimM, amb, flashLight);

    const U = {
      uTime: { value: 0 },
      uPx: { value: 1 },
      uLen: { value: SP.L },
      uOrders: { value: 1.6 },
      uFringeGain: { value: 0.4 },
      uSway: { value: new THREE.Vector2() },
      uRing: { value: new THREE.Vector2() },
      uPulse: { value: new THREE.Vector3(-1, -1, 0) },
      uImpact: { value: new THREE.Vector4(CONTACT.x, CONTACT.y, 0, 0) },
      uFlash: { value: new THREE.Vector4(CUT.x, CUT.y, CUT.z, 0) },
      envMap: { value: envTex }
    };

    // ---- the drop: back faces, then front faces, both light-additive over the backdrop
    const dropGeo = buildDropGeometry();
    const glassUniforms = {
      envMap: U.envMap, uTime: U.uTime, uLen: U.uLen, uOrders: U.uOrders, uFringeGain: U.uFringeGain,
      uSway: U.uSway, uRing: U.uRing, uPulse: U.uPulse, uImpact: U.uImpact, uFlash: U.uFlash
    };
    const glassBack = new THREE.Mesh(dropGeo, new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: glassUniforms, vertexShader: GLASS_VERT, fragmentShader: GLASS_FRAG, defines: { BACK_PASS: 1 },
      transparent: true, depthWrite: false, premultipliedAlpha: true, side: THREE.BackSide
    }));
    const glassFront = new THREE.Mesh(dropGeo, new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: glassUniforms, vertexShader: GLASS_VERT, fragmentShader: GLASS_FRAG,
      transparent: true, depthWrite: false, premultipliedAlpha: true, side: THREE.FrontSide
    }));
    glassBack.renderOrder = 10;
    glassFront.renderOrder = 11;
    glassBack.frustumCulled = glassFront.frustumCulled = false;

    const frost = new THREE.Mesh(dropGeo, new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uLen: U.uLen }, vertexShader: FROST_VERT, fragmentShader: FROST_FRAG, side: THREE.DoubleSide
    }));
    frost.frustumCulled = false;

    const shards = buildShards(new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, envMap: U.envMap }, vertexShader: SHARD_VERT, fragmentShader: SHARD_FRAG, side: THREE.DoubleSide
    }));

    const additive = function (params) {
      params.transparent = true; params.depthWrite = false;
      params.blending = THREE.CustomBlending; params.blendEquation = THREE.AddEquation;
      params.blendSrc = THREE.OneFactor; params.blendDst = THREE.OneFactor;
      return new THREE.ShaderMaterial(params);
    };
    const dust = buildDust(additive({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uPx: U.uPx, uLife: { value: new THREE.Vector2(50, 60) }, uColor: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0.22, 0.26, 0.32) } },
      vertexShader: DUST_VERT, fragmentShader: DUST_FRAG
    }));
    const lead = buildLeadSpray(additive({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uPx: U.uPx, uLife: { value: new THREE.Vector2(0.5, 1.7) }, uColor: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0.20, 0.21, 0.24) } },
      vertexShader: DUST_VERT, fragmentShader: DUST_FRAG
    }));
    const glints = buildGlints(shards, additive({
      uniforms: { uTime: U.uTime, uPx: U.uPx }, vertexShader: GLINT_VERT, fragmentShader: GLINT_FRAG
    }));
    dust.renderOrder = 20; lead.renderOrder = 20; glints.renderOrder = 21;

    // ---- metals
    const brushed = brushedTexture();
    const steel = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x8d939c, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.70, roughnessMap: brushed, bumpMap: brushed, bumpScale: 0.0005, envMapIntensity: 1.0
    });
    const boltMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x3a3d44, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.38 });
    const anodized = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x15171d, metalness: 0.9, roughness: 0.42, envMapIntensity: 0.9 });
    const rubber = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x060607, metalness: 0.0, roughness: 0.9 });
    const bulletMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.40, envMapIntensity: 1.1 });
    const spallMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x70747c, metalness: 1.0, roughness: 0.36, envMapIntensity: 0.85 });

    const nip = buildNippers(steel, boltMat);
    const dl = Math.hypot(CUT.tx, CUT.ty) || 1;
    nip.dx = CUT.tx / dl; nip.dy = CUT.ty / dl;           // tail direction at the cut: the tool's long axis
    nip.rot = Math.atan2(-nip.dy, -nip.dx);
    nip.px = CUT.x + nip.dx * NIP.LJ; nip.py = CUT.y + nip.dy * NIP.LJ;
    const clampRig = buildClamp(anodized, rubber);
    const bullet = buildBullet(bulletMat);
    const spall = buildSpall(spallMat);

    const flash = makeGlow(0.50, 0.72, 1.0, 1.0);
    const frontGlow = makeGlow(0.60, 0.80, 1.0, 0.0);
    const burst = makeGlow(0.65, 0.82, 1.0, 0.0);
    const spark = makeGlow(1.0, 0.82, 0.60, 0.6);

    scene.add(glassBack, glassFront, frost, shards.mesh, dust, lead, glints, nip.group, clampRig,
      bullet.mesh, spall.mesh, flash, frontGlow, burst, spark);

    S = {
      renderer: renderer, scene: scene, camera: camera, U: U,
      glassBack: glassBack, glassFront: glassFront, frost: frost, shards: shards.mesh, dust: dust, lead: lead, glints: glints,
      nip: nip, bullet: bullet, spall: spall, flash: flash, frontGlow: frontGlow, burst: burst, spark: spark, flashLight: flashLight,
      tmp: {
        o: {}, m4: new THREE.Matrix4(), q: new THREE.Quaternion(), p: new THREE.Vector3(), sc: new THREE.Vector3(),
        dir: new THREE.Vector3(), xAxis: new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), zero: new THREE.Matrix4().makeScale(0, 0, 0)
      }
    };
    fitCamera();
    renderer.compile(scene, camera);
    const warm = [1.5, 3.95, 5.0, 6.6];           // touch every program / buffer once so nothing hitches mid-shot
    for (let i = 0; i < warm.length; i++) renderAt(warm[i]);
    return S;
  }

  /* fixed 35-degree camera on +Z; distance chosen so the drop sits inside the central 70 % */
  function fitCamera() {
    const w = window.innerWidth, h = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
    const aspect = w / h, tanH = Math.tan(FOV * Math.PI / 360), FILL = 0.66;
    const dist = Math.max(SP.halfH / (FILL * tanH), SP.halfW / (FILL * tanH * aspect));
    S.camera.aspect = aspect;
    S.camera.position.set(0, 0, dist);
    S.camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    S.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    const buf = S.renderer.getDrawingBufferSize(new THREE.Vector2());
    S.U.uPx.value = buf.y / (2 * tanH);
  }

  /* =====================================================================
   *  Analytic state: every quantity below is a closed-form function of t
   * ===================================================================== */
  function swayLower(t) {                       // head ringing after the hit (cantilevered from the clamp)
    if (t <= T_IMPACT) return 0;
    const tau = t - T_IMPACT, win = 1 - smoothstep(2.9, 3.6, t);
    return -win * (0.060 * Math.exp(-2.4 * tau) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 5.2 * tau) +
                   0.036 * Math.exp(-1.5 * tau) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 1.45 * tau));
  }
  function swayUpper(t) {
    if (t <= T_IMPACT) return 0;
    const tau = t - T_IMPACT, win = 1 - smoothstep(2.9, 3.6, t);
    return win * 0.016 * Math.exp(-2.0 * tau) * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 7.5 * tau);
  }
  const BULB_SWAY_W = Math.pow((S_CLAMP - S_BULB) / S_CLAMP, 2);
  const SHIFT_DET = swayLower(T_IMPACT + BUL.TDET) * BULB_SWAY_W;

  function updateBullet(t, shift) {
    const B = S.bullet, m = B.mesh, tau = t - T_IMPACT;
    if (tau <= 0) {                             // free flight, +X -> -X
      setBulletShape(B, 0);
      m.position.set(CONTACT.x - BUL.V * tau, CONTACT.y, 0);
      m.rotation.set(BUL.SPIN * t, 0, 0);
      m.visible = true;
      return;
    }
    setBulletShape(B, consumed(tau));
    const spin = BUL.SPIN * T_IMPACT + BUL.SPIN * (1 - Math.exp(-8 * tau)) / 8;
    if (tau <= BUL.TDET) {                      // pinned against the ringing bulb while it mushrooms
      m.position.set(CONTACT.x + shift, CONTACT.y, 0);
      m.rotation.set(spin, 0, 0);
      m.visible = true;
    } else {                                    // spent slug rebounds, tumbles and drops away
      const td = tau - BUL.TDET;
      m.position.set(CONTACT.x + SHIFT_DET + 0.55 * td, CONTACT.y + 0.18 * td - 1.25 * td * td, 0.25 * td);
      m.rotation.set(spin, 0, -0.95 * td);
      m.visible = m.position.y > -14;
    }
  }

  function updateSpall(t) {
    const mesh = S.spall.mesh, D = S.spall.data, T = S.tmp;
    if (t <= T_IMPACT || t >= 3.9) { mesh.visible = false; return; }
    mesh.visible = true;
    const tau0 = t - T_IMPACT;
    for (let i = 0; i < D.n; i++) {
      const age = tau0 - D.tau[i];
      const life = 1 - smoothstep(D.f0[i], D.f0[i] + 0.7, t);
      if (age <= 0 || life <= 0) { mesh.setMatrixAt(i, T.zero); continue; }
      const k = D.k[i], e = 1 - Math.exp(-k * age), f = e / k, ek = 1 - e;
      T.p.set(D.x0[i] + D.vx[i] * f, D.y0[i] + D.vy[i] * f - G_SPALL * (age - f) / k, D.z0[i] + D.vz[i] * f);
      T.dir.set(D.vx[i] * ek, D.vy[i] * ek - G_SPALL * e / k, D.vz[i] * ek);
      const speed = T.dir.length() || 1;
      T.dir.multiplyScalar(1 / speed);
      T.q.setFromUnitVectors(T.xAxis, T.dir);
      const sz = D.size[i] * life * smoothstep(0, 0.05, age);
      T.sc.set(sz * (1 + Math.min(2.6, speed * 0.33)), sz, sz);   // molten streaks stretch along their flight
      T.m4.compose(T.p, T.q, T.sc);
      mesh.setMatrixAt(i, T.m4);
    }
    mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  function updateNippers(t) {
    const N = S.nip;
    const adv = easeInOut((t - 2.6) / 0.75);
    let back = NIP.HOVER * (1 - adv) + 0.012 * Math.sin(t * 2.3) * (1 - adv);
    let ang;
    if (t <= 2.75) ang = NIP.OPEN;
    else if (t <= T_TOUCH) ang = lerp(NIP.OPEN, NIP.TOUCH, easeInOut((t - 2.75) / (T_TOUCH - 2.75)));
    else if (t <= T_SNIP) { const u = (t - T_TOUCH) / (T_SNIP - T_TOUCH); ang = NIP.TOUCH * (1 - u * u); }
    else ang = 0;
    let kick = 0;
    if (t > T_SNIP) {                           // snap recoil, then the tool backs away
      const ts = t - T_SNIP;
      kick = 0.022 * Math.exp(-9 * ts) * Math.sin(46 * ts);
      back += 0.02 * Math.exp(-7 * ts) * Math.sin(40 * ts) + 0.8 * smoothstep(4.6, 6.4, t);
      ang = 0.16 * smoothstep(4.9, 6.3, t);
    }
    N.group.position.set(N.px + N.dx * back, N.py + N.dy * back, 0);
    N.group.rotation.z = N.rot + kick;
    N.a.rotation.z = ang / 2;
    N.b.rotation.z = -ang / 2;
  }

  function setGlow(m, x, y, z, scale, intensity) {
    m.visible = intensity > 0.003;
    m.position.set(x, y, z);
    m.scale.set(scale, scale, 1);
    m.material.uniforms.uI.value = intensity;
  }
  function updateGlows(t) {
    // triboluminescent flash at the cut
    let fI = 0;
    const ts = t - (T_SNIP - 0.03);
    if (ts > 0) fI = smoothstep(0, 0.07, ts) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0, ts - 0.07) / 0.16) * (0.86 + 0.14 * Math.sin(ts * 90));
    S.U.uFlash.value.w = fI;
    S.flashLight.intensity = 2.2 * fI;
    setGlow(S.flash, CUT.x, CUT.y, 0.2, 1.3 + 2.0 * fI, 2.0 * fI);
    // glow riding on the crack front
    let gI = 0, gs = 1, gx = CUT.x, gy = CUT.y, gz = 0;
    if (t > T_SNIP && t < T_WAVE1 + 0.5) {
      const o = spineAt(frontS(t), S.tmp.o);
      gx = o.x; gy = o.y; gz = o.z;
      gI = (t < T_WAVE0 ? 0.45 * smoothstep(T_SNIP, T_SNIP + 0.15, t) : 0.85) * (t > T_WAVE1 ? Math.exp(-(t - T_WAVE1) / 0.1) : 1);
      gs = 0.55 + 4.2 * o.r;
    }
    setGlow(S.frontGlow, gx, gy, gz + 0.1, gs, gI);
    // the head letting go
    const bI = smoothstep(T_WAVE1 - 0.22, T_WAVE1, t) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0, t - T_WAVE1) / 0.2);
    setGlow(S.burst, BULB.x, BULB.y, 0.3, 3.0 + 2.2 * smoothstep(T_WAVE1 - 0.2, T_WAVE1 + 0.5, t), 0.8 * bI);
    // spark where lead meets glass
    const sI = smoothstep(T_IMPACT - 0.012, T_IMPACT + 0.02, t) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0, t - T_IMPACT - 0.02) / 0.075);
    setGlow(S.spark, CONTACT.x + 0.02, CONTACT.y, 0.3, 1.1 + 1.2 * sI, 1.1 * sI);
  }

  /* Evaluate and draw the complete scene at logical time simTime (pure function of its argument). */
  function renderAt(simTime) {
    if (!S) return;
    const t = clamp(+simTime || 0, 0, DURATION);
    const U = S.U;
    U.uTime.value = t;

    // elastic ringing of the clamped drop
    const swLo = swayLower(t);
    U.uSway.value.set(swLo, swayUpper(t));
    const shift = swLo * BULB_SWAY_W;

    // photoelastic state: residual fringes, impact contact field, ringing, travelling pulses
    const tau = t - T_IMPACT;
    let ringAmp = 0, ringPh = 0, contact = 0, gain = 0.20 + 0.015 * Math.sin(t * 2.1);
    if (tau > 0) {
      ringAmp = 0.17 * Math.exp(-1.5 * tau);
      ringPh = 2 * Math.PI * 6.5 * tau;
      contact = smoothstep(0, 0.04, tau) * 1.9 * Math.exp(-tau / 0.33) * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * 6.5 * tau));
      gain += 0.26 * Math.exp(-tau / 0.7);
    }
    U.uRing.value.set(ringAmp, ringPh);
    U.uImpact.value.set(CONTACT.x + shift, CONTACT.y, 0, contact);
    const pw = smoothstep(2.5, 2.75, t) * (1 - smoothstep(3.75, 3.95, t));
    const ph = (t - 2.6) / 0.62;
    U.uPulse.value.set(-0.15 + 1.3 * (ph - Math.floor(ph)), -0.15 + 1.3 * (ph + 0.5 - Math.floor(ph + 0.5)), 0.9 * pw);
    U.uFringeGain.value = gain + 0.07 * pw;

    updateBullet(t, shift);
    updateSpall(t);
    updateNippers(t);
    updateGlows(t);

    const broken = t > T_SNIP - 0.02;
    S.frost.visible = broken && t < T_WAVE1 + 0.6;
    S.shards.visible = S.dust.visible = S.glints.visible = broken;
    S.glassFront.visible = S.glassBack.visible = t < T_WAVE1 + 0.08;
    S.lead.visible = t > T_IMPACT && t < T_IMPACT + 2.6;

    S.renderer.render(S.scene, S.camera);
  }

  /* =====================================================================
   *  Playback state machine + dock
   * ===================================================================== */
  const State = Object.freeze({
    COUNTDOWN: 'COUNTDOWN', PLAYING: 'PLAYING', PAUSED: 'PAUSED', REFIRE_HOLD: 'REFIRE_HOLD', ENDED: 'ENDED'
  });

  function boot() {
    const elCountdown = document.getElementById('countdown');
    const elToggle = document.getElementById('btn-toggle');
    const elRefire = document.getElementById('btn-refire');
    const elIconPause = document.getElementById('icon-pause');
    const elIconPlay = document.getElementById('icon-play');
    const elScrubber = document.getElementById('scrubber');
    const pills = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.speed-pill'));

    let state = State.COUNTDOWN;
    let playbackSpeed = 1.0;
    let countdownElapsed = 0;                   // wall-clock seconds
    let holdElapsed = 0;                        // wall-clock seconds
    let countdownStart = null, holdStart = 0, lastNow = null;

    try {
      initScene();
    } catch (err) {
      S = null;                                 // the dock keeps working even without WebGL
      if (window.console && console.error) console.error(err);
    }

    function showCountdown(text) {
      if (elCountdown.textContent !== text) elCountdown.textContent = text;
      if (elCountdown.style.display !== 'block') elCountdown.style.display = 'block';
    }
    function hideCountdown() {
      elCountdown.style.display = 'none';
      elCountdown.textContent = '';
    }
    function setToggleIcon(running) {           // running -> pause glyph, otherwise play glyph
      elIconPause.style.display = running ? '' : 'none';
      elIconPlay.style.display = running ? 'none' : '';
      elToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', running ? 'Pause' : 'Play');
    }
    function enterPlaying() { state = State.PLAYING; setToggleIcon(true); }
    function enterPaused() { state = State.PAUSED; setToggleIcon(false); }

    function advance(dt) {
      simTime = Math.min(DURATION, simTime + dt * playbackSpeed);
      elScrubber.value = simTime.toFixed(3);
      if (simTime >= DURATION) {
        simTime = DURATION;
        elScrubber.value = DURATION.toFixed(3);
        renderAt(simTime);
        state = State.ENDED;
        setToggleIcon(false);
        return;
      }
      renderAt(simTime);
    }

    function frame() {
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      const now = performance.now();
      if (lastNow === null) {                   // first callback after the resting frame: countdown starts at 0
        lastNow = now;
        countdownStart = now;
      }
      const wallDt = Math.max(0, (now - lastNow) / 1000);
      lastNow = now;
      if (state === State.COUNTDOWN) {
        countdownElapsed = (now - countdownStart) / 1000;
        if (countdownElapsed >= 3) {
          hideCountdown();
          enterPlaying();
          advance(Math.min(countdownElapsed - 3, 0.1));
        } else {
          showCountdown(String(3 - Math.floor(countdownElapsed)));
        }
      } else if (state === State.REFIRE_HOLD) {
        holdElapsed = (now - holdStart) / 1000;
        if (holdElapsed >= 1) {
          enterPlaying();
          advance(Math.min(holdElapsed - 1, 0.1));
        }
      } else if (state === State.PLAYING) {
        advance(Math.min(wallDt, 0.1));
      }
    }

    elToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (state === State.PLAYING) {
        enterPaused();
      } else if (state === State.COUNTDOWN || state === State.REFIRE_HOLD) {
        hideCountdown();
        simTime = 0;
        enterPaused();
      } else if (state === State.PAUSED) {
        enterPlaying();
      } else if (state === State.ENDED) {
        hideCountdown();
        simTime = 0;
        elScrubber.value = '0';
        renderAt(simTime);
        enterPlaying();
      }
    });

    pills.forEach(function (pill) {
      pill.addEventListener('click', function () {
        const v = parseFloat(pill.getAttribute('data-speed'));
        if (isFinite(v) && v > 0) playbackSpeed = v;
        pills.forEach(function (p) {
          const on = p === pill;
          p.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
          p.setAttribute('aria-checked', on ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
      });
    });

    elScrubber.addEventListener('input', function () {
      hideCountdown();                          // cancels COUNTDOWN / REFIRE_HOLD
      const v = parseFloat(elScrubber.value);
      simTime = isFinite(v) ? clamp(v, 0, DURATION) : 0;
      enterPaused();
      renderAt(simTime);
    });

    elRefire.addEventListener('click', function () {
      hideCountdown();
      simTime = 0;
      elScrubber.value = '0';
      renderAt(simTime);
      setToggleIcon(true);
      state = State.REFIRE_HOLD;
      holdElapsed = 0;
      holdStart = performance.now();
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
      if (!S) return;
      S.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
      S.renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, false);
      fitCamera();
      renderAt(simTime);
    });

    renderAt(0);                                // initial resting scene
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

"""Exercise the 5-state playback machine through the real DOM and report what happens."""
import sys, os, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from cdp import Browser

URL = 'file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-claude-fable-5.2-dptq7qe0/work/index.html'
SNAP = """(function(){
  var cd = document.getElementById('countdown'), sc = document.getElementById('scrubber');
  var ip = document.getElementById('icon-pause'), il = document.getElementById('icon-play'), bt = document.getElementById('btn-toggle');
  var pills = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.speed-pill'));
  return {
    now: performance.now(),
    cdText: cd.textContent, cdDisp: getComputedStyle(cd).display, cdInline: cd.style.display,
    scrub: sc.value,
    pauseShown: getComputedStyle(ip).display !== 'none', playShown: getComputedStyle(il).display !== 'none',
    aria: bt.getAttribute('aria-label'),
    active: pills.filter(function(p){return p.classList.contains('is-active');}).map(function(p){return p.dataset.speed;}),
    checked: pills.map(function(p){return p.getAttribute('aria-checked');}).join(',')
  }; })()"""

fails = []
def check(name, cond, detail=''):
    print(('PASS ' if cond else 'FAIL ') + name + (' :: ' + str(detail) if detail != '' else ''))
    if not cond:
        fails.append(name)

b = Browser(width=640, height=400, port=9411, extra=['--no-sandbox'])
try:
    c = b.cdp
    snap = lambda: c.evaluate(SNAP)
    click = lambda sel: c.evaluate("document.querySelector('%s').click(); 1" % sel)
    sleep = lambda s: c.pump(s)

    # ---------- initial countdown ----------
    c.events = []
    c.call('Page.navigate', {'url': URL})
    c.wait_event('Page.loadEventFired', 90)
    # timestamps relative to the first rAF after load (countdown start) are approximated by polling
    samples = []
    t_start = time.time()
    while time.time() - t_start < 4.2:
        s = snap(); s['wall'] = time.time() - t_start
        samples.append(s)
        sleep(0.05)
    seq = []
    for s in samples:
        key = (s['cdText'], s['cdDisp'])
        if not seq or seq[-1][0] != key:
            seq.append((key, s['wall'], s['scrub']))
    print('countdown sequence:', seq)
    texts = [k[0][0] for k in seq]
    check('countdown shows 3,2,1 then hides', texts == ['3', '2', '1', ''], texts)
    if len(seq) == 4:
        d32 = seq[1][1] - seq[0][1]; d21 = seq[2][1] - seq[1][1]; d10 = seq[3][1] - seq[2][1]
        print('  durations: "3"->"2" %.2fs (>= ~1 minus load offset), "2"->"1" %.2fs, "1"->hidden %.2fs' % (d32, d21, d10))
        check('each digit lasts ~1s', abs(d21 - 1.0) < 0.15 and abs(d10 - 1.0) < 0.15, (d21, d10))
        check('hidden via display none + empty text', seq[3][0] == ('', 'none'), seq[3][0])
    during = [s for s in samples if s['cdText'] in ('3', '2', '1')]
    check('scrubber stays "0" during countdown', all(s['scrub'] == '0' for s in during), set(s['scrub'] for s in during))
    check('countdown visible is display:block', all(s['cdDisp'] == 'block' for s in during))
    check('pause icon + aria Pause during countdown', all(s['pauseShown'] and not s['playShown'] and s['aria'] == 'Pause' for s in during))
    for line in c.console_dump():
        if 'exception' in line or 'console.error' in line:
            print('  ', line[:600]); fails.append('console error')

    # ---------- PLAYING advances ----------
    a = snap(); sleep(0.5); bq = snap()
    dv = float(bq['scrub']) - float(a['scrub']); dw = (bq['now'] - a['now']) / 1000
    check('PLAYING advances at 1.0x', abs(dv - dw) < 0.12, 'sim %.3f wall %.3f' % (dv, dw))

    # ---------- toggle -> PAUSED ----------
    click('#btn-toggle'); p1 = snap(); sleep(0.4); p2 = snap()
    check('PAUSED freezes simTime', p1['scrub'] == p2['scrub'], (p1['scrub'], p2['scrub']))
    check('PAUSED shows play icon + aria Play', p2['playShown'] and not p2['pauseShown'] and p2['aria'] == 'Play')
    # ---------- toggle -> PLAYING ----------
    click('#btn-toggle'); q1 = snap(); sleep(0.4); q2 = snap()
    check('resume from current simTime', float(q2['scrub']) > float(q1['scrub']) and float(q1['scrub']) >= float(p2['scrub']) - 1e-6, (p2['scrub'], q1['scrub'], q2['scrub']))
    check('PLAYING shows pause icon + aria Pause', q2['pauseShown'] and not q2['playShown'] and q2['aria'] == 'Pause')

    # ---------- speed pills ----------
    for sp in ['0.25', '2.0', '0.5']:
        click('.speed-pill[data-speed="%s"]' % sp)
        s = snap()
        exp = ','.join('true' if v == sp else 'false' for v in ['0.25', '0.5', '1.0', '2.0'])
        check('pill %s exclusive is-active/aria-checked' % sp, s['active'] == [sp] and s['checked'] == exp, (s['active'], s['checked']))
        a = snap(); sleep(0.6); bq = snap()
        dv = float(bq['scrub']) - float(a['scrub']); dw = (bq['now'] - a['now']) / 1000
        check('rate at %sx' % sp, abs(dv - dw * float(sp)) < 0.12, 'sim %.3f wall %.3f' % (dv, dw))

    # ---------- scrubbing ----------
    c.evaluate("(function(){var s=document.getElementById('scrubber'); s.value='4.6'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 1;})()")
    s1 = snap(); sleep(0.4); s2 = snap()
    check('scrub sets simTime and pauses', s1['scrub'] == '4.6' and s2['scrub'] == '4.6' and s2['aria'] == 'Play' and s2['playShown'], (s1['scrub'], s2['scrub'], s2['aria']))

    # ---------- re-fire (speed persists at 0.5) ----------
    click('#btn-refire'); r0 = snap()
    check('refire resets scrubber to "0", countdown hidden, pause icon', r0['scrub'] == '0' and r0['cdDisp'] == 'none' and r0['cdText'] == '' and r0['pauseShown'] and r0['aria'] == 'Pause', r0)
    hold = []
    t0 = time.time()
    first_move = None
    while time.time() - t0 < 1.6:
        s = snap(); s['wall'] = time.time() - t0; hold.append(s)
        if first_move is None and s['scrub'] != '0':
            first_move = s['wall']
        sleep(0.03)
    check('countdown stays hidden through REFIRE_HOLD', all(s['cdDisp'] == 'none' and s['cdText'] == '' for s in hold))
    check('hold lasts ~1.0s before PLAYING', first_move is not None and 0.9 <= first_move <= 1.2, first_move)
    s = snap()
    check('speed persisted across refire', s['active'] == ['0.5'], s['active'])

    # ---------- refire then toggle during hold -> PAUSED at 0 ----------
    click('#btn-refire'); sleep(0.3); click('#btn-toggle'); t1 = snap(); sleep(1.3); t2 = snap()
    check('toggle during REFIRE_HOLD -> PAUSED at 0', t1['scrub'] == '0' and t2['scrub'] == '0' and t2['aria'] == 'Play' and t2['cdDisp'] == 'none', (t1['scrub'], t2['scrub'], t2['aria']))

    # ---------- scrub during hold cancels it ----------
    click('#btn-refire'); sleep(0.2)
    c.evaluate("(function(){var s=document.getElementById('scrubber'); s.value='7.9'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 1;})()")
    sleep(1.2); s = snap()
    check('scrub during REFIRE_HOLD cancels hold and pauses', s['scrub'] == '7.9' and s['aria'] == 'Play', (s['scrub'], s['aria']))

    # ---------- run to the end -> ENDED ----------
    click('.speed-pill[data-speed="2.0"]'); click('#btn-toggle'); sleep(0.6); e = snap(); sleep(0.4); e2 = snap()
    check('ENDED clamps at 8 with play icon', e['scrub'] == '8' and e2['scrub'] == '8' and e['playShown'] and not e['pauseShown'] and e['aria'] == 'Play', (e['scrub'], e['aria']))
    # ---------- toggle from ENDED restarts immediately ----------
    click('#btn-toggle'); z0 = snap(); sleep(0.5); z1 = snap()
    check('toggle from ENDED restarts at 0 and plays', float(z0['scrub']) < 0.2 and float(z1['scrub']) > float(z0['scrub']) and z1['aria'] == 'Pause' and z1['cdDisp'] == 'none', (z0['scrub'], z1['scrub'], z1['aria']))

    # ---------- toggle during initial COUNTDOWN ----------
    c.events = []
    c.call('Page.navigate', {'url': URL})
    c.wait_event('Page.loadEventFired', 90)
    sleep(0.8); click('#btn-toggle'); k1 = snap(); sleep(2.8); k2 = snap()
    check('toggle during COUNTDOWN -> PAUSED at 0, countdown hidden', k1['cdDisp'] == 'none' and k2['cdDisp'] == 'none' and k2['scrub'] == '0' and k2['aria'] == 'Play', (k1['cdDisp'], k2['scrub'], k2['aria']))
    click('#btn-toggle'); sleep(0.5); k3 = snap()
    check('then toggle -> PLAYING from 0', float(k3['scrub']) > 0 and k3['aria'] == 'Pause', k3['scrub'])

    # ---------- determinism: same simTime -> identical pixels (forward, backward, after refire) ----------
    HASH = """(function(t){
      var s=document.getElementById('scrubber'); s.value=String(t); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));
      var cv=document.getElementById('stage'); var gl=cv.getContext('webgl2')||cv.getContext('webgl');
      var w=gl.drawingBufferWidth,h=gl.drawingBufferHeight; var px=new Uint8Array(w*h*4);
      gl.readPixels(0,0,w,h,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,px);
      var hsh=2166136261>>>0, nz=0; for (var i=0;i<px.length;i++){ hsh^=px[i]; hsh=Math.imul(hsh,16777619)>>>0; if(px[i]) nz++; }
      return hsh+':'+nz; })(%s)"""
    times = [0, 1.25, 1.6, 2.9, 3.95, 4.7, 5.5, 6.2, 8]
    fwd = [c.evaluate(HASH % t) for t in times]
    bwd = [c.evaluate(HASH % t) for t in reversed(times)][::-1]
    click('#btn-refire'); sleep(0.1)
    again = [c.evaluate(HASH % t) for t in times]
    check('frame-exact: forward == backward scrubbing', fwd == bwd, [(t, f, g) for t, f, g in zip(times, fwd, bwd) if f != g])

  function buildEnvironment(renderer) {
    const env = new THREE.Scene();
    const disposables = [];
    const add = function (geo, r, g, b, side) {

      const m = add(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h), r, g, b, THREE.DoubleSide);
      m.position.set(x, y, z);
      m.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    };
    panel(KEY_POS[0], KEY_POS[1], KEY_POS[2], 5.2, 5.2, 6.4, 6.8, 7.4);      // key soft-box, cool white
    panel(7.6, -0.8, 6.2, 4.0, 6.5, 0.9, 1.1, 1.4);                          // fill
    panel(CYAN_POS[0], CYAN_POS[1], CYAN_POS[2], 1.5, 14, 1.3, 6.2, 7.2);    // cyan rim strip
    panel(MAG_POS[0], MAG_POS[1], MAG_POS[2], 1.5, 14, 6.8, 1.4, 5.6);       // magenta rim strip
    panel(0, 10.5, -1.5, 8, 3.5, 3.0, 3.2, 3.6);                             // top bank
    panel(0.5, -6.5, -8.5, 10, 1.4, 1.8, 2.1, 2.6);                          // low back kicker
    panel(3.2, 5.4, 9.5, 0.55, 0.55, 34, 34, 36);                            // hard catch-light
    panel(-2.2, -1.0, 10.5, 0.7, 12, 2.2, 2.4, 2.7);                         // tall strip: long highlight down the tail
    const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(renderer);
    const target = pmrem.fromScene(env, 0.02, 0.1, 100);
    pmrem.dispose();
    for (let i = 0; i < disposables.length; i++) disposables[i].dispose();
    return target.texture;
  }

  /* brushed-metal streak map (roughness + bump), built from the seeded PRNG */
  function brushedTexture() {
    const W = 256, H = 256, data = new Uint8Array(W * H * 4);
    const row = new Float32Array(W);
    for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
      for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) row[x] = rnd();
      const bias = rnd();
      for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        let acc = 0;
        for (let k = -18; k <= 18; k++) acc += row[(x + k + W) % W];
        const v = clamp(0.55 + (acc / 37 - 0.5) * 2.0 + (bias - 0.5) * 0.22, 0, 1);
        const i = (y * W + x) * 4, b = Math.round(v * 255);
        data[i] = b; data[i + 1] = b; data[i + 2] = b; data[i + 3] = 255;
      }
    }
    const tex = new THREE.DataTexture(data, W, H, THREE.RGBAFormat);
    tex.wrapS = tex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    tex.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
    tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
    tex.generateMipmaps = true;
    tex.repeat.set(1.3, 5.0);
    tex.needsUpdate = true;
    return tex;
  }
